reading.title: Casting Our Play
reading.purpose: Hear two friends choose parts for a class play.
paras: "We need a cheerful dog and a shy mouse," says Mei. "I am loyal, so I can be the dog," says Jon. "Ali is bold, so Ali is the sneaky fox," says Mei.
"Who is stubborn?" asks Jon. "The donkey is. The goat is generous," says Mei. "I am determined!" says Ali.

qs.q: The fox is sneaky. What does sneaky mean?
choices: Doing things quietly so others do not notice.
qs.why: A sneaky fox acts quietly so nobody notices.

qs.q: Mei says the goat is generous. What does generous mean?
choices: Happy to give or share with others.
Not willing to change your mind.
qs.why: Generous means happy to give or share. Mei says the goat is generous, and the donkey is the stubborn one.
